digest.component_or_area: CI/CD workflow and complexity measurement gate
propositions: complexity-baseline.json lacks CI enforcement to prevent changes, unlike module-size-limit.txt which is locked against main in _build-and-test.yml
the current baseline test does not prevent adding new entries at high complexity; only existing ceiling values and stale entries are guarded
the module-size lock fails open (warning + continue) on failed git fetch, allowing unverified branch values to pass comparison
the lock mechanism must be semantic (entry-by-entry) not byte-equality, to allow legitimate shrinkage while blocking raises and new entries
CI must fail closed when the base complexity-baseline.json from main cannot be fetched, and module-size lock must match this behavior
adding a function exceeding C901 threshold with a matching baseline entry in the same change must be rejected by CI
